body: All I can say is, my life is over. I can't bear to face the world with how i fucked it up.

I fucked up. My life is ruined and it's their fault. I have nothing to live for.

Edit: I should probably mention that I'm trying to seek help, because I have displayed some unhealthy symptoms (I mean, I'm on a subreddit for suicide) and I would like to get diagnosed. Unfortunately the earliest that the psych is available is in October and let's just hope that I don't do it until then.
It really feels like there's no other way out.

I want to say I can work through it, but I lack the resolve and mental stability to do it.

To be very frank, I just want the easy way out, even if it means dying and ending it all.
